article.headline: Jordan Stiemke scores 22 off bench to lead Loyola Maryland over Mount St. Mary's 77-69
article.description: — Jordan Stiemke scored 22 off the bench to lead Loyola Maryland over Mount St. Mary's 77-69 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Jordan Stiemke scores 22 off bench to lead Loyola Maryland over Mount St. Mary's 77-69

categories.description: Loyola Maryland Greyhounds @ Mount St. Mary's Mountaineers

event.description: Loyola Maryland Greyhounds @ Mount St. Mary's Mountaineers

keywords: Loyola Maryland Greyhounds @ Mount St. Mary's Mountaineers
article.story: EMMITSBURG, Md. -- — Jordan Stiemke scored 22 off the bench to lead Loyola Maryland over Mount St. Mary's 77-69 on Saturday night. Stiemke also had five rebounds for the Greyhounds (5-4). Jacob Theodosiou had 13 points and Braeden Speed scored 11. The Mountaineers (6-4) were led by Dola Adebayo's 14 points. Terrell Ard Jr. added 13 points, six rebounds and four steals. Javon Ervin had 13 points and six rebounds. Loyola Maryland took a 16-6 lead in the first half with an 11-0 run. Stiemke had 10 points to lead Loyola Maryland to a 35-24 lead at halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
